user.title: Connect your Skylight transmitter
user.description: Choose the BLE advertising action and the BLE Adv Proxy Name sensor from the same ESPHome proxy. This integration controls the factory mesh network, so all matching panels in range may respond. Power is assumed; synchronize it after setup or reconnect.
